text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the Bills of Sale (Removal of Books and Documents) Rules.

heading.en: Register book not to be removed from Registry

text.en: 2. No volume of any register book or index kept in the Registry of Bills of Sale under the Bills of Sale Act or any rules made thereunder and no document filed or deposited in such Registry shall be removed therefrom except under an order of the Minister.

heading.en: Auditor-General may require production of documents

text.en: 3. Notwithstanding rule 2, it shall be lawful for the Auditor-General to require the production at his office of any such document for the purpose of audit at any time when the Registry of Bills of Sale is not open to the public.
